channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Vorcaro disse que Moraes reclamou "MUITO" de evento em Londres
item.description: Messages obtained by the Federal Police reveal that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro worked together to organize the II London Brazil Legal Forum, with Moraes complaining about the event's disorganization and blocking guests like Tarcísio. Communications between Vorcaro, staff, and involved groups show internal disagreements, including with Grupo Voto, prior to the event's cancellation. The case also raises suspicions about political influence over the programming of an international legal forum.

item.title: Crusoé: Mensagens revelam objetivo do contrato de Viviane com Master
item.description: Messages reveal that the 129 million reais contract between the office of Viviane Barci de Moraes, wife of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, and Banco Master, owned by Daniel Vorcaro, aimed to funnel resources to Crusoé, a left-wing project led by Lula. The disclosure raises suspicions about indirect Supreme Court influence over the economy and tense political-institutional relationships.

item.title: Cleitinho defende Renan Santos e o perdoa após ser chamado de "câncer"
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo defended Renan Santos after campaign suspension, forgiving prior insults and criticizing the STF's monocratic decision. He labeled the suspension undemocratic and a censorship of social media, advocating for changes to prevent Supreme Court unilateral decisions.

item.title: Governo Lula diz que a atual fiscalização das bets é insuficiente
item.description: The Lula administration acknowledges that the regulation and oversight of sports betting have been insufficient, noting impacts on health, family relationships, and household debt. A meeting was held with ministers and social representatives to discuss new measures, focusing on combating organized crime and protecting Brazilian families.

item.title: Lindbergh pede ao STF afastamento de Flávio do mandato de senador
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a petition with the STF requesting the suspension of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) from office. The request asks the Attorney General's Office to examine possible removal from the senate term.

item.title: Caso Master: decisão sobre novas revelações cabe ao plenário do STF
item.description: The STF plenary will decide the next steps in the Master Case following the PF report, which includes messages allegedly sent by Daniel Vorcaro to minister Alexandre de Moraes. The PGR will analyze the information before opening a new investigation. No investigation has been opened against STF ministers or cited authorities.

item.title: Toffoli recua e libera campanha eleitoral de Renan Santos nas redes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli authorized the online campaign advertising for Renan Santos's ticket from the Missão party, using addresses already registered with the TSE. The ruling permits digital campaigning through social media and official channels.

item.title: Celina aciona STF contra lei sancionada por Lula que impacta Fundo do DF
item.description: The Federal District governor, Celina Leão (PP), filed a lawsuit with the STF against a law signed by Lula (PT) affecting the DF Constitutional Fund, reducing resources for security, health, and education. The GDF claims a provision inserted in Congress submits the FCDF to fiscal restrictions, with an estimated loss of R$1.8 billion in 2027.

item.title: OAB vê “crise” no Supremo e manifesta preocupação em ano eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) expressed concern over the crisis at the Supreme Federal Court, following the disclosure of a dispute between ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça. The entity advocates for rigorous and impartial investigations, ensuring constitutional rights during the electoral period.

item.title: Relatório da PF cita pedido a Gonet para fazer candidato desistir de disputa pelo comando de conselho de procuradores
item.description: A Federal Police report reveals a conversation in which lawyer Ciro Soares told Daniel Vorcaro that he convinced Attorney General Paulo Gonet to persuade a candidate to withdraw from the race for CNPG presidency in favor of Jarbas Soares Júnior. The exchange was found on Vorcaro's phone and made public following a ruling by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. The communication occurred on April 14, 2024, three days before the election for the position.

item.title: OAB defende 'apuração rigorosa' após revelações de mensagens de Vorcaro para Moraes
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association calls for strict investigation following Daniel Vorcaro's messages to Minister Moraes, demanding transparency. The case involves communications between the Banco Master executive and the Supreme Court. The organization emphasizes the importance of impartiality between powers.

item.title: Toffoli libera participação de Renan Santos em debates e financiamento de campanha após críticas no TSE
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli suspended restrictions on Renan Santos' (Mission) presidential campaign, reconsidering his decision and allowing participation in debates and campaign funding. The measure follows criticism of the court.

item.title: Toffoli revoga decisão que restringiu campanha de Renan Santos
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli partially overturned the suspension of Renan Santos' campaign, restoring social media, electoral funds, and debates, but keeping profiles off content recommendations. Renan has 72 hours to disclose profile creation details and potential electoral violations under review by the PGE.

item.title: Vorcaro tinha contrato de R$ 50 mi com escritório Barci de Moraes, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police uncovered a R$50 million contract between Vikings Participações, linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro, and the law firm Barci de Moraes, represented by Viviane de Moraes, wife of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The agreement involved the transfer of luxury assets, including shares in a jet and helicopter, with intercepted messages suggesting immediate use of these assets and expenses covered for individuals such as Pedro Gonet, son of the Attorney General. The probe is part of the Compliance Zero operation, investigating fraud at Banco Master.

item.title: Damares quer Senado sem votações por renúncia ou impeachment de Moraes
item.description: Senator Damares Alves proposed blocking all Senate votes until Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes resigns or is impeached, protesting André Mendonça's decision to declassify a PF report containing messages between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The move could jeopardize priority government bills such as the MP on the 'taxa da blusinha' and the PEC on the 6×1 shift schedule.

item.title: Toffoli libera campanha digital de Renan Santos
item.description: TSE minister Dias Toffoli ruled to reopen the digital campaign of Renan Santos, a candidate from the Missão party for the Brazilian Presidency, after a prior restriction. The decision also grants debate participation and access to the electoral budget. Platforms like Meta and TikTok were instructed to reactivate the candidate's profiles.

item.title: Aliados de Lula veem "cortina de fumaça" em vazamento de Moraes e Vorcaro
item.description: Allies of President Lula see a 'smokescreen' in the timing of Minister André Mendonça's decision to make public the messages exchanged between Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. Lula's supporters note the disclosure coincides with new revelations in the Dark Horse case, which targets bolsonaristas, and demand equal transparency regarding information about people close to Lula. They believe the move may shift focus away from other investigations during the electoral period.

item.title: Justiça proíbe material de campanha de candidato a deputado em SP com fotos de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: A São Paulo Electoral Court judge banned state representative candidate Lucas Bove (PL) from using images of Jair Bolsonaro in campaign materials, ruling it constitutes a prohibited political statement under Supreme Federal Court restrictions. The ruling responded to a complaint by councilwoman Duda Hidalgo (PT), who reported the use of the former president's photos on street billboards. The judge determined that Bolsonaro’s prominently displayed image conveys a message of political support to voters, violating the judicial order restricting the former president’s political activities.

item.title: Renan explica por que rejeitou reunião com Toffoli
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos, running under the Missão banner, explained that his party's legal team will not attend a meeting with the office of TSE Justice Minister Dias Toffoli following the suspension of his campaign. Santos suggested that engaging in dialogue could result in a formal request being submitted to the electoral court.

item.title: Vorcaro preparou “experiência completa” para Moraes e esposa: "Ultra vips"
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro arranged a VIP lunch at Six Senses Botanique in Campos do Jordão for Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and his wife, described as an 'ultra vip' complete experience. Seized messages indicate detailed logistics, including transport and security, involving Fábio Faria and Patrícia Abravanel. The case emerged in the Compliance Zero operation report.

item.title: O encontro da Esfera que reunirá ministro de Lula e coordenadora econômica de Flávio
item.description: Esfera Brasil will host the Seminário Brasil on September 14, bringing together Lula’s ministers and Flávio Bolsonaro’s economic coordinator. Key speakers include Dario Durigan (Finance), Márcio Elias Rosa (Development), and Daniella Marques, alongside figures like Aloizio Mercadante (BNDES).

item.title: TSE julga proibição de deepfakes e pode impactar mais de 50 ações eleitorais
item.description: The TSE is set to rule on Tuesday on the ban of deepfakes in campaigns, affecting over 50 cases in electoral courts. The decision aims to restrict AI-manipulated content that misleads voters, except for clearly identified satire. Rules for 2026 have been tightened due to advances in AI tools.

item.title: 'Pqp. Não pagaram Barci de Moraes. Vamos ter problemas', reclamou Vorcaro
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro complained in messages about delayed payments to the office of Viviane Barci de Moraes, wife of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The messages were found on Vorcaro's phone during a Federal Police operation.

item.title: Falso juiz preso já foi candidato a prefeito de cidade no interior de SP
item.description: Selmo dos Santos Pereira, a law student who impersonated a judge during a police stop in São Bernardo do Campo, previously ran for mayor of Juquitiba in 2012 under the PRP, receiving just over 40 votes. He had also attempted to run for federal deputy under the Democrats in 2010, but his candidacy was rejected by the TSE due to his imprisonment for fraud. During the recent traffic stop, he presented fake identification and falsely claimed to be a judge, but was recognized by witnesses and taken to police custody.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende que Moraes renuncie cargo no STF: ‘Não tem mais condições de permanecer’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro calls for Alexandre de Moraes to resign from the STF if corruption allegations involving banker Daniel Vorcaro are confirmed. He labels the accusations serious and questions the minister's conduct. Bolsonaro made the statements after chairing a session of the Public Security Committee in the Senate.

item.title: Em carreata, Arruda promete construir metrô e hospital no Sol Nascente
item.description: During a campaign rally in Ceilândia, José Roberto Arruda (PSD), candidate for Governor of the Federal District, promised a new metro line connecting Sol Nascente to Águas Lindas (GO) to ease traffic in Brasília. He also proposed building a new hospital in the region to improve healthcare access.

item.title: Moraes manda forças de segurança destruírem armas de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the destruction or donation of former President Jair Bolsonaro's weapons after his conviction in a coup plot. The measure covers seized firearms except one previously mentioned. Bolsonaro is under house arrest for health reasons.

item.title: ‘Oramos para que o País continue avançando’: grupos evangélicos divulgam carta de apoio a Lula
item.description: Evangelical groups issue a letter supporting Lula's 2026 reelection, emphasizing social policies and democratic defense. The move aims to reduce resistance from evangelicals who make up 26.9% of Brazil's population and typically align with the far-right. The organizations reference Isaiah 1:17 and reinforce the connection between the Gospel and policies such as Bolsa Família and Minha Casa Minha Vida.

item.title: Renan Santos ingressa com mandado de segurança no TSE contra decisão de Toffoli
item.description: Renan Santos and Aroldre Medina, from the Missão Party, filed a writ of mandamus with the TSE against a ruling by Toffoli that suspended part of the ticket's campaign. The minister's decision included the suspension of digital advertising, Fundo Eleitoral transfers, and participation in debates.

item.title: Leia conversas de Vorcaro com Moraes antes de prisão
item.description: Revelaed messages show banker Daniel Vorcaro asked Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes whether he should leave Brazil two days before his arrest by federal police in November 2025. The conversations suggest Moraes shared sensitive information about the investigation, including possible dates and times of police operations. Vorcaro was arrested on November 17th while attempting to board a private jet bound for Malta and Dubai.

item.title: É #FAKE vídeo de JK prevendo 'homem mau' na Presidência do Brasil no século XXI; cena foi manipulada com IA
item.description: A manipulated video uses AI to alter footage of Juscelino Kubitschek, falsely claiming he predicted the rise of a 'bad man' to the Brazilian presidency in the 21st century. The original content shows JK discussing the construction of Brasília, with no political predictions. The video is classified as fake by fact-checking platforms.

item.title: Flávio chama Moraes de 'advogado de Vorcaro' e diz que ministro pode não ter condições de seguir no STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro publicly criticized Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, calling him 'Daniel Vorcaro's lawyer' and questioning his continued tenure at the STF amid suspicions of involvement in a R$130 million contract. He highlighted investigations suggesting the minister's participation in drafting the agreement and demanded clarifications, threatening the judge's continuity on the bench.

item.title: Vai à Câmara prioridade no fomento ao patrimônio cultural imaterial
item.description: The Senate Committee on Education and Culture approved priority funding for culturally significant expressions such as jongo, frevo, and capoeira circles. The amendment, introduced by Senator Camilo Santana, moves to the Chamber of Deputies and modifies the law establishing the National Culture System.

item.title: Pesquisa Real Time Big Data traz número que surpreende mais que a alta de Augusto Cury, diz cientista político
item.description: The Real Time Big Data survey shows Lula leading the first round with 38%, but a surprising second-round simulation places Ronaldo Caiado ahead of the president, with 45% versus 43%. Political scientist Marco Antônio Teixeira highlighted the rise of Augusto Cury, who reached 11%, but emphasized the most unexpected finding: the technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, with 44% each. Despite the margin of error, the scenario indicates an extremely tight electoral race.

item.title: Em SC, Zema defende parceria privada para gestão de escolas públicas e critica influência de sindicatos
item.description: Romeu Zema advocates for private partnerships to manage public schools and criticizes unions for promoting equal pay without recognizing merit. He proposes decentralizing education, granting more autonomy to states.

item.title: Flávio evita indicar posição sobre 6x1 e volta a defender PEC alternativa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro avoided taking a clear stance on ending the 6x1 schedule and defended an alternative PEC that would flexibilize labor relations, allowing workers to negotiate directly with employers.

item.title: Brasileiro de Triathlon define campeões nacionais e classificados para o Mundial
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian Standard Triathlon Championship, held in Brasília, crowned national champions and qualified 56 athletes for the 2027 World Championship in Germany. Top female performers included Beatriz Ribeiro (F25-29), Marina Berti (F35-39), Manoela Amaral (F40-44), and Nuzia Naila Gomes Batista (F45-49), while Rafael Brandão, Lynneker Genesis Fernandes da Silva, Rafael Aragão Queiroz de Freitas, and Raimundo Sabino Alves excelled in the men's categories.

item.title: Com subida de Cury, Lula já não é a única preocupação de Flávio
item.description: With Augusto Cury's rise in the polls, Flávio Bolsonaro faces new competition on the right, but remains the leading anti-Lula candidate. Despite his competitive position, victory is not assured, while the secondary conservative field remains distant.

item.title: Longe da disputa entre grandes potências (por Marcos Magalhães)
item.description: The article examines how international media will perceive the 2026 Brazilian elections, focusing on the rivalry between the United States and China and how a victory by Flávio Bolsonaro or Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva could impact the influence of these powers in Brazil. It also questions this perspective by mentioning the choice of a supercomputer supplier, illustrating the complexity of international relations.

item.title: Plataformas retiram perfis de Renan Santos do ar, após decisão de Toffoli
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli ordered the suspension of Renan Santos' campaign and the removal of his digital profiles after the candidate delayed by 12 days in submitting the list of accounts used to seek votes. Platforms such as Meta and YouTube took down the candidate's accounts; Santos complied with the decision but announced an appeal to the TSE, criticizing the measure as overly drastic.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro intensificam a disputa pela atenção de empresários e banqueiros
item.description: Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) intensify their competition for the attention of business leaders and bankers through parallel dinners in São Paulo and Brasília, seeking support from influential economic sectors. The rivalry reflects narrowing polls in a potential runoff and the strategic importance of higher-income voters, where Flávio leads.

item.title: Como o ‘efeito Cury’ fez Caiado se arrepender de desprezo a slogan
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) surpassed Ronaldo Caiado (União) in third place in the polls, causing Caiado to regret not adopting a less aggressive stance. Caiado's campaign focused on attacking Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro without proposing changes, while Cury jumped nine percentage points in one week.

item.title: PIB desacelera e cresce 0,5% no segundo trimestre
item.description: Brazil's GDP grew 0,5% in the second quarter of 2026, slowing down from 1,1% in the first quarter. The growth was driven by the agricultural sector, while services, industry and family consumption showed weak or negative performance. The economy accumulated a 1,9% increase over the last four quarters.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio vai à Comissão de Segurança Pública do Senado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro participates in the Senate Public Security Committee to discuss bills on public security, firearms and violence prevention.

item.title: E os outros 2,7 mil candidatos, Toffoli?
item.description: A survey found 2,744 candidates failed to report social media addresses, prompting Minister Dias Toffoli to suspend part of Renan Santos' (Missão) digital campaign. The case involves deputies who also did not disclose social media data. The decision raises questions about selective enforcement of electoral rules.

item.title: O que move os eleitores de Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo a Real Time Big Data
item.description: The Real Time Big Data survey reveals that Lula's voters are primarily motivated by identification with the candidate, while Flávio Bolsonaro's supporters vote more based on political leader endorsements and rejection of opponents. Over half of Lula's voters say they like him or agree with his ideas, whereas only 16% of Flávio's voters cite personal preference or ideological alignment.

item.title: “Dark Horse”: novo pagamento eleva repasses de Vorcaro a R$ 65 mi
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro made the seventh payment of $1.6 million to the Havengate Development fund, financier of the film 'Dark Horse', 8 days after being pressured by Flávio Bolsonaro. Total investment reaches $12.3 million (R$65 million), with a possible eighth payment in October.

item.title: Em jantar, Lula pede a empresários que comparem seu vice com o de Flávio
item.description: At a dinner at Planalto Palace, Lula asked business leaders to compare his running mate, Geraldo Alckmin, with Flávio Bolsonaro’s, Alfredo Gaspar. The president highlighted economic management and denied tensions with Central Bank chief Galípolo, emphasizing the BC's independence. Guests discussed public security and fiscal concerns.

item.title: Lula amarra apoio do Centrão no Congresso, mas isso garante votos na eleição?
item.description: Lula secures tactical support from Centrão in Congress without formal alliances, relying on pragmatism and parliamentary amendment budget. Leaders like Kassab signal backing, but parties remain independent, balancing institutional interests and political agenda.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Governo e Congresso postergam decisão sobre ajuste fiscal para depois da eleição
item.description: The Lula government submitted the 2027 budget proposal with a surplus of R$18.6 billion, maintaining a cautious stance until after the 2026 elections. Economic ministers signal deeper fiscal adjustments will be negotiated with Congress post-election. While the proposal includes triggers on revenues and expenditures, the market expects stronger measures to lower interest rates.
